title: The Claude limits meter shows current numbers again even when api/oauth/usage answers 429

fields.why: The usage server refuses the app's poll persistently (HTTP 429 at 13:42Z and 13:53Z after 12 min quiet), so the meter has no reading; separate from the load panel

text: UsagePoller.swift polls api/oauth/usage every 150s (10-min backoff on 429), writes Genlock/voice/usage.json; meter = UsageMeter in AppUpdater.swift. Each poll's outcome now goes to ~/Library/Application Support/Genlock/usage-poll.txt: repeated 429. Commit 63c3d25 removed app sessions' statusLine, so the poll is the only source (genlock status-line in lib/voice.mjs could be a second). Already fixed: launch cleanup no longer deletes usage.json; 'limits –' placeholder built. Never read the keychain token without TJ's OK. Relaunch only with open -g.
